create_tandem_dqn_agent: create a TandemDqn agent with active and passive networks for reinforcement learning
step_tandem_dqn_agent: step the TandemDqn agent with a dm_env timestep to select an action and learn
set_training_mode: set the TandemDqn agent training mode to active, passive, or active_passive
get_agent_state: get the TandemDqn agent state as a dictionary for serialization and checkpointing
replace_module_params: replace selected module parameters in a target network using source network values
